Exercise three. Your compass has been withdrawn, so that you do not come to depend on it. You have been issued a thermometer. Although the red fluid in the thermometer may look tasty, we advise that you do not attempt to drink it. It is, surprisingly, highly toxic. Press 1 to hold it up and wait for the reading to settle. Then open your map, show the temperature heatmap, and guess somewhere exactly as warm as here.
